title: Ex 1.2 #4 · {n ∈ ℤ : 2 < n < 5} × {n ∈ ℤ : |n| = 5}
prompt: List the elements of $\{n \in \mathbb{Z} : 2 < n < 5\} \times \{n \in \mathbb{Z} : |n| = 5\}$ between braces. (Steps may call the two factors $A$ and $B$, in that order.)
answer_format: A set of ordered pairs between braces, like {(1, a), (2, b)}. Spaces are optional. Steps are optional.
hints: First list each factor: the integers strictly between 2 and 5, and the integers with |n| = 5.
Then pair each element of the first factor with each element of the second: 4 pairs in all.
solution: The first factor is $A = \{3, 4\}$ and the second is $B = \{-5, 5\}$.
Pair each element of A with each element of B.
